name: What is the difference between backyard remodeling and landscaping?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between backyard remodeling and landscaping in a home renovation project?
mainEntity.text: What is the difference between backyard remodeling and landscaping in a home renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Landscaping and backyard remodeling overlap, but they are not the same. Landscaping usually refers to planting, irrigation, lawn or turf, soil preparation, and the visual soft-surface elements of the yard. Backyard remodeling is broader and typically includes patios, retaining walls, pergolas, outdoor kitchens, fire features, lighting, drainage corrections, and sometimes pools or spas. In Los Angeles, many homeowners start by saying they want landscaping, but the actual need is a backyard remodel because the space needs structure, flow, and utility planning. Understanding the difference helps set the right budget and hire the right team. If the goal is just to refresh plant material, landscaping may be enough. If the goal is to create an outdoor living environment, remodeling is the more accurate term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Landscaping usually focuses on plants, soil, irrigation, and basic surface improvements, while backyard remodeling can include hardscape, structures, utilities, lighting, kitchens, pools, and full outdoor living design. Remodeling is broader and more construction-driven than landscaping alone.
